evidence.statement: Established phylogenetic/taxonomic lineage is now the default external coordinate scaffold for locating representation transformations; LIFE-CODE will not reinvent the species tree.
The C. elegans-concentrated parameter clue is most efficiently bracketed by close C. briggsae followed by deeper ecdysozoan Drosophila rather than another arbitrary broad panel.
LC-PRED-0043/0044/0045 freeze C. briggsae replication, C. elegans-to-C. briggsae transfer, and lineage-ordered transfer before new sequence acquisition.

unknowns: Depth of the C. elegans parameter clue on the metazoan/ecdysozoan/nematode tree.
